name: foundry-connect
description: Run the Foundry Connect pipeline lifecycle from Claude: explore runs, access and analyze results, share them back, author processes, build or extend pipelines, and launch runs and apps over the Foundry Connect remote MCP server. Includes the foundry-pipelines and foundry-pipeline-dev skills and the /foundry-* commands. The optional chat channel is the separate foundry-connect-channel plugin.

instance_host.title: Foundry Connect instance hostname
instance_host.description: Your Foundry Connect HOSTNAME ONLY, e.g. foundry.your-org.edu. Do not include https://, do not include a trailing slash, and do not include /mcp. The plugin supplies all three itself, building https://<hostname>/mcp. Do not paste the connector URL from the Connect to Claude page; that one is a full URL.
